summary: Form I-485, “Application to Register Permanent Residence or Adjust Status”, is the form you file with USCIS to get a green card without leaving the United States. You fill it in yourself if you are in the United States and qualify in an immigrant category, usually through a family member, an employer, asylum or refugee status.
